scope: Readonly post-seal main-panel true-family QP decomposition; no pressure score, new fit, parameter choice, model selection or intervention.

definition.selection_difference: M_selected_selection32-M_true_selection32 with both coefficients fitted only on train64

interpretation_limits: The diagnostic true family uses raw stored supports in its count penalty even if an edge fits zero response. Here none of the 240 fitted true families collapsed, so raw and active true counts coincide; this must be rechecked in weak-edge pressure studies.

Selected and true support families are often non-nested. Lower true-family minimum MSE is not a universal requirement; only same-bound nested-family inclusion gives a monotonic feasible-set comparison.
A static alpha ranking reversal of these two fixed fitted points is not the number of cases a rerun at another alpha would recover.
Noise, P/Q measurement error and AC-to-linear mismatch coexist. This decomposition separates the fit term from line-count penalty, not noise from physical-model bias.
Training J and final selection32 MSE serve different stages. A true J better than the final selected J does not by itself contradict the optimum of a particular earlier conditional MIQP.
